# Asankhaya Sharma

> AI/ML researcher and entrepreneur focused on generative AI, software security, and LLM inference optimization. Co-founder and CTO of Patched (YC S24), founder of SecuradeAI, and creator of the open-source projects OptiLLM and OpenEvolve.

Asankhaya Sharma holds a PhD in Computer Science from the National University of Singapore (thesis: Certified Reasoning for Automated Verification) and a BTech from NIT Warangal. Career highlights:

- Co-Founder & CTO, Patched (YC S24), 2024–2026: generative AI and LLMs for private, secure, multi-file code fixes through open-source workflow automation.
- Founder & CEO, SecuradeAI, 2022–2024, with the mission to make the world safer, one step at a time.
- Director of Incubation, Veracode, 2019–2022: site leader for Veracode operations in Singapore.
- Director of Software Engineering, CA Technologies, 2018–2019.
- Head of R&D, SourceClear, 2014–2018 (acquired by CA Technologies in 2018).
- Senior Software Engineer, Microsoft (SQL Server 2008, Visual Studio 2010).

Research covers inference-time compute for LLMs, evolutionary algorithm discovery, software composition analysis, vulnerability detection, and program verification. Awards include the ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award (MSR 2020).

## Open source

- [OpenEvolve](https://github.com/codelion/openevolve): LLM-driven evolutionary coding agent for algorithm discovery
- [OptiLLM](https://github.com/codelion/optillm): optimizing inference proxy implementing inference-time techniques that improve LLM reasoning
